name: Phone Shop
author: Max
description: Data-driven phone-shop workspace: one inventory database, multi-item sales, customer transfers, Fawry/Aman service payments, client debt, seven tracked accounts, business-day reconciliation, expenses, top-ups, internal transfers, stock adjustments, and configurable fees. No phone-shop logic is hardcoded into Max.

properties.prop_account_notes: Physical shop cash. Enter the real opening amount when opening the first business day.

Starter provider rule: 0.5% min 1 max 15. Vodafone publishes 1 EGP for Vodafone-to-Vodafone and 0.5% for other wallets; recipient network is intentionally not tracked in this workspace, so override the calculated provider fee when needed. Store fee starts at 10 per 1000 and is editable.

InstaPay transfer fee starter rule: 0.1%, minimum 0.50 EGP, maximum 20 EGP. Store fee starts at 10 per 1000 and is editable.

Tracked Fawry merchant/POS balance. Identifier can be filled later. Merchant commissions and service deductions vary by service; configure them in Services & Fees.

Tracked Aman merchant/POS balance. Identifier can be filled later. Aman states merchants receive a percentage on bill payments, but exact rates are merchant/service-specific; configure them in Services & Fees.

properties.prop_product_notes: Use for an untracked sale line. Enter description, quantity and price; the zero stock movement created by the generic workflow is hidden from normal inventory-movement views.

properties.prop_service_notes: Review Fawry/Aman merchant commission and exact provider deduction for this service. Store fee can be None, Fixed, Percentage, Per Block, or Percentage + Min/Max. Recharge VAT is seeded at 14% where applicable.
